edits.summary: Added the clientInfo protocol-detection exception (#542/#539) inside the rewritten Decision 4.

Rewrote Decision 4: identity for ctx_doctor/ctx_upgrade comes from the --agent <id> install-time flag, not clientInfo/_meta. Made it an explicit accepted decision, referenced in the r3 Q-list, added a GP1 case (no-clientInfo client still resolves agent id).
Corrected DiscoverResult field list (supportedVersions, capabilities, instructions, ttlMs, cacheScope) and moved serverInfo to the result's _meta key, per schema.ts:678-696.
Added concrete project-source values for Codex CLI and Copilot CLI (--agent <id> install-time flag).
Added explicit read-path rule for Codex (process argv at launch) and a contract-test reference (tests/contracts/codex-source.test.ts).
Added note: ctx_route is an internal mcp_tool hook dispatch target, not listed in tools/list.
Named the mechanism explicitly: ${workspaceFolder} launch arg as the one named source for VS Code Remote-WSL, no fallback.
No new fix needed; pass A's finding (listed vs hidden, decided in ADR-0007/0008) confirmed correct, not repeated.

Reworded Q5 from 'full v1 scope' to 'new scope (not v1 parity)': v1 only detected curl/wget directly (routing.mjs:735-765). Added a GP3 case per wrapper token (sudo, env, time, nice, timeout, xargs, command, bash -c/sh -c, $(), backticks).
Added a bash-command-redirect-deny per-adapter table row for Copilot CLI, marked modifiedArgs support unverified, confirm live before release.

Clarified the ADR-0016 selection claim: shares the greedy-shape with ADR-0009, scoring formula (BM25 vs weight x recency x repeat) differs. (Primary text lives in ADR-0016, out of this task's file ownership; recorded here as the paired doc.)

Documented the correct Claude Code Case B cell (deny with rewritten command, no updatedInput, per Q3/4bc292fc) and that the LV1 label should be removed. (Primary table lives in ADR-0016, out of this task's file ownership; recorded here as the paired doc.)
Added a gap cross-reference: OpenCode 2 has no v1 hook-fix history, so GP-LIVE-HOOKS needs purpose-built cases. (Primary edit target is TECH-SPEC §9 G25 row, out of this task's file ownership.)
Routed GS6 wall-clock number to the owner as an explicit open question; the line still reads 'Proposal' until answered, then becomes a dated decision.

Documented the single write path into the one shared context.db: server writes its own ctx_* journal rows at handler-return time; hooks write rows only for other adapters' host tools; both use the #645 path resolver. Retired the 'server never writes' rule. Added a GP6 case for a failed ctx_execute call with no PostToolUse fixture.
Added the rule that injected bytes must be byte-identical across every request within a turn (#822 cache-prefix lesson).
Split the OpenCode 2/Kiro row: Kiro resolved as not supported (no compaction signal of any kind), documented as a known gap for Q20+; OpenCode 2 kept on live-test-first.
Confirmed Qwen's delivery path stays SessionStart(compact): Qwen's PreCompact hook fires too early for the pending-flag pattern used by Gemini/Copilot CLI/VS Code.

Scoped the 'only re-injection point' claim to Claude Code/Codex/Qwen/ZCode; named the second path for Gemini/Copilot CLI/VS Code (PreCompact pending flag, UserPromptSubmit injects) so it no longer contradicts the delivery table.
Confirmed: Q19 re-probe must run before release sign-off; no other doc change needed, no v1-behavior risk carried forward.

note: A33 and B3 name file 0008 in plan.json but their primary table text lives in ADR-0016 (out of this task's ownership, 0006-0009 only). Added paired cross-reference text in 0008 instead of editing 0016.
